description: This file defines and customizes date and culture information for the 'eu-ES' (Basque - Spain) locale using the DateJS library. It includes culture-specific data such as day and month names, date formats, parsing regex patterns, timezone info, and extended date manipulation methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Clears the time component of a Date object, setting hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name based on an offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for a timezone name.

methods.name: toISOString
methods.description: Converts the date to ISO string format.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple components of a date object based on a configuration object.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Sets the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Sets the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves to the nth occurrence of a specified day of week in the month.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves to a specific day of week with an orientation.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves to a specific month.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Calculates the week number of the date.

methods.name: getISOWeek
methods.description: Returns the ISO week number.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the week number for the date.

methods.name: getOrdinalNumber
methods.description: Returns the ordinal number of the day within the year.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone abbreviation.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the date's timezone offset.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone using an offset or name.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Determines if the date's timezone observes daylight saving time.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the current date/time is within daylight saving time.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset string.

methods.name: getElapsed
methods.description: Returns milliseconds elapsed since the date.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the date.
